fields.title: 📖 Imām Aḥmad: Īmān rises and falls
fields.body:
🖋️ **Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“Imām Aḥmad said: ‘Īmān is word and deed; it rises and falls; when you do good, it rises, and when you neglect, it falls.’”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Īmān is not only a claim in the heart. It is strengthened by obedience and weakened by sin and neglect.

immutable.source: 📝 Über Imām Aḥmad, zitiert in Ziyādat al-Īmān wa Nuqṣānuh, S. 120.
immutable.book: Masāʾil al-Imām Aḥmad / Ahl al-Sunnah wa-l-Jamāʿah
